login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Internal system. Accounts are created by an administrator.
login.noSignUp: There is no self sign-up. Ask your manager or the system administrator for an account.

error.invalidCredentials: These credentials do not match our records.
error.accountLocked: This account is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts. Contact administration.
error.sessionInvalid: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.
error.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.message: No records match what you are looking for.

error.title: Something went wrong.
error.message: This data could not be loaded. Try again.

denied.title: You do not have access
denied.message: You do not have permission to view this content. Contact your system administrator if you believe this is a mistake.

ping.title: Infrastructure health
ping.subtitle: A live round-trip against the versioned API, measured in this browser.

impersonation.banner: You are signed in as {name} ({role}). Everything you do is recorded against your own account.
impersonation.leave: Leave and return to your account

users.title: Employees
users.subtitle: Accounts are created here. There is no self sign-up.
users.rolesUnavailable: There is no role you are permitted to assign, so the form is unavailable.

confirm.deactivateMessage: {name} will be signed out of every device and blocked from signing in. Their customers, deals and reports stay where they are. The account is never deleted.
confirm.reactivateMessage: {name} will be able to sign in again. They will need to enter their password.

form.name: Name
form.noAssignableRoles: There is no role you are permitted to assign.
form.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
form.passwordNotHere: Passwords are changed by the account holder, with a code sent to their email.
form.passwordPolicy: The password must be at least 8 characters and contain both letters and numbers.
form.emailTaken: That email address already belongs to an account.
form.roleNotAssignable: You may not assign that role.
form.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
form.rejected: The change was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
form.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

details.title: Employee details
details.neverActive: Not signed in on any device
details.devicesExplainer: Devices this employee is currently signed in on. Signing one out ends that session immediately.
details.noDevices: This employee is not signed in on any device.

confirm.title: Sign this device out?
confirm.message: This ends the session immediately on that device. {name} will have to sign in again there.

error.own: This is the device you are using. Sign out to end this session.
error.gone: That device is no longer signed in.
error.userGone: That employee is no longer available.
error.denied: You do not have permission to sign this device out.
error.rejected: The request was refused. Reload the page and try again.
error.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

roles.title: Roles & Permissions
roles.subtitle: Grant or revoke permissions per role. Changes take effect on the next request — nothing is deployed and nothing is restarted.
roles.immutableNotice: {role} has unconditional access to everything, granted by the role itself rather than by these rows. Editing them would change nothing, so they are locked.
roles.saved: Saved. {granted} granted, {revoked} revoked. In effect from the next request.
roles.savedNoChange: Saved. Nothing had changed, so nothing was recorded.
roles.lockedReason: No role may hold this action. Deletion is never granted — records are deactivated or archived instead.

diff.title: Confirm the changes to {role}
diff.summary: {granted} permission(s) will be granted and {revoked} will be revoked.
diff.effect: This is a configuration change, not a deployment: the next request each affected person makes is already checked against the new matrix.

create.title: Create a role
create.explainer: A new role starts with no permissions. Grant them on this screen once it exists — the change takes effect on the next request.
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores. Used in URLs and cannot be changed later.
create.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter.
create.name: Name (English)
create.nameInvalid: Enter a name of at least two characters.
create.nameArHint: Optional. Without it, the English name is shown in both languages.
create.thenGrant: You will be taken to this role's permissions once it is created.

confirm.title: Archive this role?
confirm.message: {name} and every permission it holds will be archived. Nothing is deleted, and a role somebody is assigned to cannot be archived.

error.slugTaken: Another role already uses that identifier.
error.nameTaken: Another role already uses that name.
error.nameArTaken: Another role already uses that Arabic name.
error.invalid: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
error.systemRole: That role is part of the system and cannot be archived.
error.roleInUse: People are still assigned to that role. Move them to another role first.
error.gone: That role no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
error.immutable: This role's permissions cannot be edited.
error.forbidden: One of the selected permissions may not be granted to any role.
error.staleMatrix: One of the selected permissions no longer exists. Reload the screen and try again.
error.denied: You do not have permission to change roles.
error.rejected: The change was rejected. Nothing was saved.
error.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Nothing was saved.

account.title: Account security
account.subtitle: Your password and the devices signed in to your account.

password.title: Change password
password.explainer: We email a verification code before the change is applied.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.signsOutEverywhere: Changing your password signs you out on every device, including this one.

challenge.title: Confirm the change
challenge.intro: We sent a verification code to {email}. Enter it to finish changing your password.
challenge.label: {length}-digit code
challenge.expired: This code has expired. Send a new one.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.explainer: Sign out any device you do not recognise. Sessions also end on their own after eight idle hours.
devices.revokedOthers: Every other device was signed out.

error.currentPassword: Your current password is not correct.
error.codeInvalid: That code is not valid. Check it, or send a new one.
error.codeExpired: That code has expired. Send a new one and try again.
error.policy: The new password does not meet the password rules.
error.unchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
error.challengeFailed: The verification code could not be sent. Try again shortly.
error.resendLimited: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes before asking for another.
error.deviceIsCurrent: This is the device you are using. Sign out to end this session.
error.deviceGone: That device is no longer signed in.
error.rejected: The change was refused. Reload the page and try again.
error.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Everything this system runs on: the company, its defaults, its currencies and its limits.

section.title: Company & defaults
section.description: The company details and the values new records start from.

error.load: These settings could not be loaded. Try again.
error.save: The settings were not saved. Try again.

rounding.title: Rounding per currency
rounding.description: Rounding applies to the final total only, using this currency's unit. Switching it off leaves the total unrounded. Either change affects new quotations only, never one already issued.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.description: Rates are entered by hand and kept forever. Recording a new rate never changes a quotation that already captured one.

empty.title: No rates recorded yet
empty.message: Record the first exchange rate using the form above.

error.load: The currencies could not be loaded. Try again.
error.save: The rounding was not saved. Try again.
error.rates: The rate history could not be loaded. Try again.
error.record: The rate was not recorded. Try again.

limits.title: Limits & SLAs
limits.subtitle: The thresholds, deadlines and ceilings this system enforces. Five of the six have never been configured.

error.load: These limits could not be loaded. Try again.
error.save: The limits were not saved. Try again.
